subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a supported public cron, Gateway, hook, and plugin status, or should yielded handoff remain an internal nonterminal lifecycle state until a normal terminal result exists?
rationale: The PR expands a persisted and public compatibility-sensitive status contract across multiple consumers. Code review can identify the settlement defects, but cannot determine whether that new permanent product/API state is desired.

options.title: Keep handoff internal
options.body: Track yielded handoff internally and publish or persist a normal terminal cron result only after descendant reconciliation completes.

options.title: Approve public deferred
options.body: Retain `deferred` as a supported public status and require explicit upgrade, persistence, CLI, protocol, hook, plugin, and operator-behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep handoff internal
recommendation.body: Track yielded handoff internally and publish or persist a normal terminal cron result only after descendant reconciliation completes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history spans the affected agent, cron task-ledger, and Discord lifecycle surfaces, and the same owner introduced the original yielded-subagent pause behavior.
